name: JTF_RS_SALESREPS_
description: This table stores information about salesreps. Salesrep_id is the primary key. If resource category is 'OTHERS' then  salesrep_number and org_id are unique.

columns.name: RESOURCE_SALESREP_ID
columns.description: Unique Salesrep Identifier

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the resource party. Foreign key to the HZ_PARTIES.PARTY_ID.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SALES_CREDIT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Sales Credit Type Identifier ( FK to so_sales_credit_types)

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of salesrep whether he or she is active in AR or not ( Used for OTHER type of Salesreps)

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date this salesrep becomes active

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Date this salesrep becomes inactive

columns.name: SALESREP_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number given to  salesrep ( used for OTHER type of salesreps)

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: WH_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: wh update date ( used by AR)

columns.name: SALES_TAX_GEOCODE
columns.description: sales tax geocode ( used by AR)

columns.name: SALES_TAX_INSIDE_CITY_LIMITS
columns.description: sales Tax inside city limits ( used by AR)

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
